reviews.title: Great bang for buck, don't pass these up if you need 120mm fans
reviews.comment: Good quality fans, good price. Kind of sad that only one of them fit, the front ones seem to be 92mm. Can't speak to noise as I haven't used them long enough, but they seem good.
reviews.author: Jerem

reviews.title: A fan of these fans
reviews.comment: Quality products for a custom build or replacing fans on an AIO liquid CPU cooler. Avaialability, Price, and quick shipping makes this a great deal, most bang for the bucks....
reviews.author: Ronald Layaoen

reviews.title: Buenos ventiladores para la pc
reviews.comment: Estos ventiladores realmente valen la pena ofrecen un excelente flujo de aire y mantienen el mi pc bastante fresca incluso bajo carga y funcionan de manera sorprendentemente silenciosa. Lo mejor es que por el precio que tienen, la calidad de construcción y el rendimiento que brindan superan lo que uno esperaría en esta gama. Son una opción económica pero muy eficiente
reviews.author: Juan Andrés Ruiz

reviews.title: Perfect for budget builds
reviews.comment: Perfect for my setup. They work as advertised. Speeds are confirmed and smidgen higher. Was looking for budget, fast, non RGBs and found them.
reviews.author: frank slater

reviews.title: quiet and sleek no led look
reviews.comment: adjustable to be quiet and all run off each other i used these for my exhaust fans at 30% power with no noise. they all plugged into 4 pins into the mobo i did not interlink them
reviews.author: Aaa
